_meta.title: vat.law — Snap Manifest v1
_meta.description: Machine-readable registry of all runtime modules, workflows, templates, and infrastructure files. vat.law is Vertical #25 of Supreme Operating System — AI-native UK complex-VAT navigator. Regulated complex-VAT advice on customer specific facts is signed off by CTA / CIOT / ATT partner firms.
_meta.regulatory_dependency: CTA / CIOT / ATT (Chartered Institute of Taxation / Association of Taxation Technicians). vat.law is a non-regulated technology platform — MTD VAT submission, deterministic complex-VAT computation, audit trail. Complex-VAT advice on customer specific facts (partial-exemption methodology agreements, TOMS election, capital goods scheme, HMRC enquiry response, voluntary disclosure) is signed off by CTA / CIOT / ATT partner firms (3 seed firms). HMRC MTD VAT API is sanctioned; no portal RPA required.

regulatory_boundaries.vat_law_role: Technology platform · MTD VAT submission · deterministic complex-VAT computation · audit trail — NOT a regulated tax adviser on customer specific facts
regulatory_boundaries.cta_partner_role: CTA / CIOT / ATT partners hold regulated complex-VAT advice (partial-exemption methodology agreements, TOMS election, CGS dispute, HMRC enquiry response, voluntary disclosure)
regulatory_boundaries.supreme_capital_role: FCA AR for advance financing on assessed HMRC liabilities
regulatory_boundaries.hmrc_role: Tax authority · operates the MTD VAT API · issues registration numbers · enforces returns · imposes LPP 1/2 surcharges and penalty points (April 2025 escalation) · conducts s.29 / sch.36 enquiries · accepts voluntary disclosures
regulatory_boundaries.named_authorised_officer_role: Customer's own VAT-authorised officer (director / finance lead / their accountant) · remains the legal user of the MTD VAT API · co-signs every return submission
regulatory_boundaries.subscription_revenue: Essentials £19 · Pro £49 · Cross-Border £149 · HMRC enquiry £495 one-off
regulatory_boundaries.regulator_facing_comms_rule: Every regulator-facing output (MTD submission, OSS return, HMRC enquiry response, partial-exemption methodology memo) requires CTA partner sign-off. India QA pre-screens. NEVER auto-send.
